_comment: Schema violations of the NIST MBE PMI AP242 test files (HAECCEITY_NIST_PMI), grouped by
entity, kind and attribute. 'own': against the table of the file's own edition (null when
there is none: editions 2 and 3); 'upgrade': against the target edition 4, as if its
FILE_SCHEMA were changed to it (null for edition 4 files). Verdicts: file-wrong (the file
violates the schema text cited), edition-difference (valid in its own edition, not in the
target), undetermined. Line numbers are of 242_mim_lf.exp (edition 4) unless stated.
